verdict.rationale: Gitleaks ships a first-party GitHub Action that automatically scans every pull request and commit, comments on PRs, and alerts named accounts. It also offers a pre-commit hook that runs on each commit. These are event-triggered automations that depend on GitHub workflows and git hooks, not a standalone background or agentic automation system. missing for 10: a documented recurring or scheduled background scan, a standalone automation runner independent of CI or git hooks, agentic or autonomous remediation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
